channel.title: PAGASA NCRPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA NCRPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 8:40 AM, 03 November 2026(Tuesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Orani, Samal, Abucay, Balanga, Orion, Pilar, Limay, and Mariveles), Bulacan (Hagonoy and Paombong), Cavite (Noveleta, Cavite City, Tanza, and Rosario), and Pampanga (Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Macabebe, and Masantol) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
